question: Which deity should be worshipped to the east of Siddheśvarī on Bilvakūṭa?
premises: The location is east of Siddheśvarī
Virūpākṣa is the deity to be worshipped
inference: One should worship Virūpākṣa on Bilvakūṭa to the east of Siddheśvarī.
plain_english: To the east of her, on Bilvakūṭa, one should worship Virūpākṣa.
